scope: Bounded offline operations adapter only; production files read-only

runs.stage: Initial deterministic classifier and HTTP transport tests
Initial test file syntax validation, before adding two CLI tests
Final deterministic suite including isolated child-process CLI checks

coverage: Explicit endpoint/config allowlist, duplicate rejection, HTTPS and exact-loopback-only HTTP opt-in
Local owner/standby/stopped/null scope and payload freshness/clock-skew handling
DB-clock lease expiry boundary independent of sampler wall clock; zero deadline has no fabricated age
Unknown, stale, malformed, non-writer and SQL-unreachable observations never imply absent ownership
Local counter delta continuity requires fresh same-instance external process epoch; reset/gap is not a rate
Exact pool storage/member/SQLite-owner 503 versus exhaustion/cooling 429 classification
Authenticated GET, strict TLS, no-store, no redirect/retry/proxy, bounded body and total HTTP deadline
Output projection excludes credentials, raw fields, error messages, endpoints and environment key names
Missing credentials/debug tracing fail closed before any HTTP call
Bounded concurrency and batch-publication freshness revalidation
CLI safe JSON and exit 1 for invalid invocation; exit 2 for missing credentials and unknown DB

executionBoundaries.http: Injected event emitters only; no sockets or DNS
executionBoundaries.cli: Child processes use empty environment except optional SystemRoot; example credentials unavailable, hence no endpoint requests
executionBoundaries.sql: SELECT template source-matched to production DB clock/fence; not executed

notes: Initial and final test counts overlap and must not be summed.

One compound shell syntax/CLI command was rejected by the worktree command verifier before execution; syntax checks were then run as plain commands and CLI checks were added to and executed in the final suite.

Customer SQL collector wiring, actual per-instance routing, live alert delivery, readiness/drain, and LiteLLM effective fallback/request correlation remain customer integration acceptance, not executed tests.
No new soak or 24-hour campaign. Any further approved continuous load belongs to the coordinator's single maximum-30-minute campaign.
